question: What is the meaning of life cycle assessment (lca) environmental in relation to chemical properties?
description: Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) environmental analysis in relation to chemical properties involves analyzing and quantifying the environmental aspects and impacts of product systems over their entire life cycle, considering factors such as toxicity, health effects, and eco-toxicological impacts of chemicals used in materials, products, and processes.
